changelog:
Initial release of APIDot Hunyuan 3D 3.1 API documentation skill.

- Provides documentation and workflow guidance for the Hunyuan 3D 3.1 API via APIDot, including Pro and Rapid variants, text-to-3D, and image-to-3D workflows.
- Covers async task submission, task_id handling, polling, webhook integration, geometry controls, and PBR output planning.
- Includes direct links to APIDot model pages, API docs, dashboard, and examples.
- Enforces strict security guidance for API key handling and workflow best practices.
- No executable files, scripts, or credential storage; documentation and reference only.
